Name: One Tile High Tree of the Winter Star
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Changes collision height of the Tree of the Winter Star so it's smaller
Description:
_Description
_

*   Changes collision height of the Tree of the Winter Star so it's smaller

*   I got the idea from [One Tile High Budget TV](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11781)

*   Mostly this is particularly handy if you're using a CP or AT mod that replaces the tree with something that just doesn't need to be that wide

_Quick start instructions
_

*   Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)  )

*   it's ready to play!

_Compatibility_

*   Very simple small mod that shouldn't conflict with most mods

*   mobile compatible

_Mods this would work well with
_

*   [Asters Big Furniture Pack](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240)
